definitions.gloss: view of the universe; cosmology; conception of the cosmos
definitions.explanation: A person's or culture's conception of what the universe is and how it is structured. Used in discussions of religion, philosophy, mythology, and the history of science.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古代|こだい}→古代：05324_kodai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{宇宙観|うちゅうかん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧。
examples.english: The ancient view of the universe differs from today's.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{神話|しんわ}→神話：00367_shinwa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{独特|どくとく}→独特：01656_dokutoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{宇宙観|うちゅうかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{表|あらわ}れている→表れる：14276_arawareru⟧。
examples.english: A distinctive conception of the cosmos appears in this myth.

examples.japanese: {地動説|ちどうせつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{登場|とうじょう}→登場：13625_toujou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦それ→それ：00994_sore⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{宇宙観|うちゅうかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{根本|こんぽん}→根本：13107_konpon⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{覆|くつがえ}した→覆す：07568_kutsugaesu⟧。
examples.english: The appearance of the heliocentric theory overturned the prevailing view of the universe from its very foundations.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{宇宙|うちゅう}→宇宙：01861_uchuu⟧ (universe, cosmos) + {観|かん} (view, outlook). Names a conception of what the universe is and how it is ordered. Common in writing on religion, mythology, and the history of science.

- ⟦{古代|こだい}→古代：05324_kodai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{宇宙観|うちゅうかん}: the ancient view of the universe
- {宇宙観|うちゅうかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧: for one's view of the cosmos to change
